seoTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Manchester River Cruises
seoDescription: Manchester River Cruises FAQs — everything you need to know before your cruise, from what you will see and what to wear to booking, cancellations and accessibility.
heading: Frequently Asked Questions
intro: Everything you need to know before your cruise.

items.question: What is Manchester River Cruises?
items.answer: We run sightseeing tours, events and private hire on the Manchester Ship Canal and River Irwell from Salford Quays. (TBC)

items.question: Where do you depart from?
items.answer: All cruises depart from the Millennium Footbridge at Salford Quays (M50 3RB), beside MediaCityUK.

items.question: How long are the cruises?
items.answer: The City River Tour is around 60 minutes; event and music cruises vary in length. (TBC)

items.question: Is there a bar onboard?
items.answer: Yes — most cruises have a fully licensed bar onboard. (TBC)

items.question: Can I bring children?
items.answer: Yes — daytime cruises are family-friendly. Some evening events are over-18s only. (TBC)

items.question: What will I see?
items.answer: Highlights include MediaCityUK, the Imperial War Museum North, Old Trafford and the historic docks, with live commentary along the way. (TBC)

items.question: Do I need to book in advance?
items.answer: We strongly recommend booking online in advance, especially at weekends and in peak season. (TBC)

items.question: What if it rains?
items.answer: The boat has a heated indoor cabin, so cruises run in most weather. (TBC)

items.question: Is commentary provided?
items.answer: Yes — live onboard commentary points out the landmarks along the route. (TBC)

items.question: What is the dress code?
items.answer: There's no strict dress code, but most guests dress up to make a night of it. (TBC)

items.question: Are events suitable for all ages?
items.answer: Evening music and party nights are usually over-18s; family-friendly events are clearly marked. (TBC)

items.question: Can I book a table?
items.answer: Table and group options vary by event — check the individual event for details. (TBC)

items.question: Where exactly do I board?
items.answer: Boarding is at the Millennium Footbridge, Salford Quays, M50 3RB, beside MediaCityUK.

items.question: Is there parking?
items.answer: Quayside car parks are nearby. (Details TBC.)

items.question: Which tram stop?
items.answer: Take the Metrolink to MediaCityUK; the boarding point is a few minutes' walk.

items.question: Can I amend my booking?
items.answer: Yes — use our Manage My Booking page to view, amend or cancel your booking. (TBC)

items.question: What is the cancellation policy?
items.answer: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before departure. Full policy TBC.

items.question: Do you offer group discounts?
items.answer: We welcome groups and can help with larger bookings. Group pricing TBC.

items.question: Can I buy gift vouchers?
items.answer: Yes — gift vouchers are available and redeemable against any cruise. See our Gift Vouchers page. (TBC)

items.question: Is the boat wheelchair accessible?
items.answer: Step-free boarding is available where tides allow. Full accessibility details TBC.

items.question: Are assistance dogs allowed?
items.answer: Yes — assistance dogs are welcome onboard. (TBC)

items.question: Do you cater for dietary requirements?
items.answer: Where food is served we aim to cater for dietary requirements — please let us know in advance. (TBC)
